title: librdkafka statistics snapshot envelope (legacy)
description: One line of the client-metrics.jsonl stream: a phase-tagged envelope wrapping librdkafka's own emitted statistics document. Produced by bench_statistics_callback in adapters/librdkafka-c/statistics.c every 100 ms into a bounded in-memory buffer, written after the timed phase. Validated line by line by parseSnapshots in legacy/benchctl/librdkafka-statistics/schema.mjs. Descriptive documentation of migrated behavior, not a gate.

phase.description: Run phase at capture time. Exactly one baseline and exactly one final snapshot are required, final must be last, and captured_ns must increase strictly.

statistics.description: librdkafka's own statistics document, passed through verbatim. The control plane reads only the fields below; every other field is preserved but unread.

type.description: librdkafka client type; baseline and final snapshots must report "producer".

msg_cnt.description: Producer queue gauge in records; sampled for the queue trend and required to be zero in the final snapshot.

msg_size.description: Producer queue gauge in bytes; required to be zero in the final snapshot.

brokers.description: Per-broker objects keyed by broker name. Objects with a non-negative integer nodeid supply req counters, txretries, req_timeouts, waitresp_cnt, outbuf_cnt, int_latency, outbuf_latency, and rtt.

topics.description: Per-topic objects keyed by topic name, supplying batchcnt and batchsize windows and per-partition txmsgs counters.
